description:
**Company Description** 
 Lahara Group is a next\\-generation blockchain and decentralized infrastructure company operating at the intersection of artificial intelligence, distributed systems, and post\\-quantum security. At the core of Lahara’s work is LQ1 — Lahara Quantum One, a Layer 1 blockchain designed for the demands of tomorrow’s computing landscape. LQ1 is engineered to support AI\\-native applications, DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks), and quantum\\-resilient architecture. The organization focuses on long\\-term cryptographic security, building infrastructure that can withstand evolving computational and security challenges. Team members have the opportunity to work on cutting\\-edge technology in a highly innovative environment.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\\-time, on\\-site Rust Developer role based in Kochi. The Rust Developer will design, implement, and optimize core blockchain components, smart contract frameworks, and related distributed systems using Rust. Responsibilities include writing clean, secure, and well\\-tested code, participating in architectural design discussions, reviewing code, and contributing to performance tuning and debugging. The role involves close collaboration with engineering, cryptography, and AI teams to integrate LQ1 with AI\\-native and DePIN\\-focused applications. The developer will also help maintain technical documentation, ensure best practices for security and reliability, and contribute to continuous improvement of development workflows.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong programming skills in Rust and familiarity with systems programming concepts, memory management, and concurrency.
* Experience with blockchain or distributed systems, including consensus mechanisms, peer\\-to\\-peer networking, and smart contract platforms.
* Understanding of cryptography fundamentals; interest or experience in post\\-quantum cryptography and secure protocol design is a plus.
* Background in performance optimization, profiling, and low\\-level debugging for high\\-throughput, low\\-latency applications.
* Comfort with modern development practices: Git\\-based workflows, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and documentation.
* Ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary team environment, communicate technical concepts clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with Linux environments; familiarity with AI, DePIN, or Layer 1 blockchain development is highly advantageous.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About 30 Sundays** 




 30 Sundays is a modern holiday company helping Indians plan and book international trips with high\\-quality itineraries, great stays, and seamless on\\-trip support. Founded by IIT–IIM and ex\\-Apple leaders, with a core team from Flipkart, Spinny, and OYO, and backed by leading investors including Info Edge and Eximius.
 



 We are building a consumer\\-first travel platform that transforms how people discover, plan, and book holidays — and we're growing fast.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our core engineering team. You will be an individual contributor owning critical systems and features end\\-to\\-end — writing production\\-grade code, driving technical design, and raising the engineering bar across the team.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who is deeply hands\\-on, thrives on hard technical problems, and wants to build consumer internet products at scale from the ground up.
 



  





**What You'll Build** 




*Consumer Travel App* 
 Build and scale a best\\-in\\-class travel discovery and booking experience for Indian travellers, focusing on speed, usability, and personalization. Design and implement features that move beyond traditional booking interfaces and deliver a modern, intuitive holiday\\-planning experience.
 



***Key Technical Areas***



* Travel Discovery: Design and build engaging discovery surfaces — destination feeds, curated collections, search, and filtering.
* AI \\& Personalization: Implement recommendation engines and ranking systems that adapt to user preferences and browsing behaviour.
* High\\-Performance Platform: Architect and maintain a fast, reliable, mobile\\-first backend capable of supporting 20Mn\\+ DAUs.
* Data\\-Driven Product: Instrument features with analytics, run experiments (A/B tests), and iterate rapidly based on user insights.
* Internal Tooling: Build internal platforms and ops tooling that help the business operate efficiently at scale.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Build, maintain, and scale backend services and REST APIs for the consumer app and internal platforms.
* Design secure, high\\-performance server\\-side logic using Node.js as the primary stack.
* Own data modelling, schema migrations, and query optimization across SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Write clean, modular, well\\-tested backend code and maintain high standards through code reviews.
* Debug production issues, resolve performance bottlenecks, and ensure smooth deployments.
* Integrate third\\-party APIs, data pipelines, and background processes to support both product and internal operations.
* Collaborate with product, frontend, and internal teams to translate business requirements into robust backend solutions.
* Define backend architecture patterns and best practices that scale across the engineering team.



  





**Technology Stack** 




***Core Backend***



* Runtime \\& Language: Node.js (primary), Python (secondary)
* API Layer: REST APIs, Express.js / Fastify
* Authentication: JWT, OAuth 2\\.0, session management



***Databases***



* Relational: PostgreSQL / MySQL — schema design, indexing, migrations
* NoSQL: MongoDB / Redis — caching, session storage, real\\-time data
* Search: Elasticsearch — for destination and itinerary discovery



***Infrastructure \\& DevOps***



* Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) / GCP
* Containers: Docker, Kubernetes
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions / CircleCI
* Monitoring \\& Observability: Datadog, Sentry, CloudWatch



***Async \\& Integrations***



* Message Queues: SQS, Bull / BullMQ
* Background Jobs: Cron\\-based workers, event\\-driven pipelines
* Third\\-party Integrations: Payment gateways, travel APIs, CRM and ops tools



***Developer Tooling***



* Version Control: Git, GitHub
* Code Quality: ESLint, Prettier, unit and integration testing (Jest / Mocha)
* CLI \\& Scripting: Bash, Python scripts for automation



  





**What We're Looking For** 




***Must Have***



* 3\\-6 years of backend development experience (excluding internships), with a strong track record of shipping production systems.
* Deep expertise in Node.js — you've used it to build and scale real, high\\-traffic services.
* Strong experience designing and building REST APIs, authentication systems, and server\\-side architecture.
* Proficiency in both SQL and NoSQL databases — data modelling, indexing, migrations, and query optimization.
* Experience owning production systems end\\-to\\-end, including monitoring, debugging, and incident response.
* Familiarity with Git, CLI tooling, and rigorous code review practices.
* Prior experience at a consumer internet startup is strongly preferred.



***Good to Have***



* Working knowledge of Python for scripting, automation, or data pipelines.
* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Exposure to background job systems, event\\-driven architectures, or message queues (e.g. SQS, Kafka, Bull).
* Experience building internal tooling or admin systems in addition to consumer\\-facing products.



**Preferred Education** 




 B.Tech / B.E. from IITs, top NITs, BITS Pilani, or equivalent strong engineering institutions. We value demonstrated ability and impact over pedigree.
 



  





**Why Join 30 Sundays** 



* Greenfield problem space — build systems from scratch; your architecture decisions will shape millions of trips.
* Technical depth \\+ product impact — write code that directly moves key product metrics with no layers between you and the outcome.
* Backed by top investors — Info Edge and Eximius backing with a clear path to scale.
* Travel as a perk — experience the product you build; annual travel credits included.

**Idenza.ai is building an AI\\-native fraud, risk, and compliance platform deployed across sponsor banks, fintechs, payment processors, ISOs and merchants, and crypto and stablecoin programs.** 




**Payments infrastructure is being rebuilt right now. Money is moving to instant rails and onto stablecoins, and the risk and compliance stack underneath it has not kept up. We are replacing that layer: real\\-time decisioning across card, ACH, wire, and on\\-chain transfers, with AI agents doing the investigative work that today consumes teams of analysts.** 




**That breadth is the core engineering problem. Every rail has its own risk model, its own regulator, and its own definition of an acceptable false positive rate, and they all run through one decisioning core. Every program is separately configurable and separately tuned, and every verdict has to be reconstructable for an examiner months after the fact. Our decisions have already held up under regulatory examination.** 




**Idenza is on a growth trajectory, with production volume and platform surface expanding quarter over quarter.** 




  





**What Breaks as We Scale (Why This Role Matters)** 




**As usage grows, the hardest problems shift from feature delivery to system\\-level concerns: maintaining low\\-latency decisioning under higher event throughput, preserving correctness and explainability in scoring pipelines, and introducing LLM\\-powered agents with strict guardrails suitable for regulated environments.** 




**Data models, APIs, and workflows already carrying production traffic must evolve carefully, without disruption to the systems customers run their operations on. This role exists to anticipate and solve these scaling challenges before they become operational or customer\\-impacting issues.**

* Design and build our MCP layer so agents can reach internal services, data vendors, and customer systems through a clean tool interface
* Own the eval harness for agent behavior: regression suites over real case data, measuring precision of proposed actions, false action rates, and drift as prompts, models, and rules change
